name: byline
description: Byline: on-chain identity for AI agents on NEAR. Every agent action, credited.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bylinecode/sdk && npm run build -w @bylinecode/indexer && npm run build -w @bylinecode/mcp && npm run build -w @bylinecode/agent && npm run build -w @bylinecode/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @bylinecode/sdk && npm test -w @bylinecode/indexer && npm test -w @bylinecode/mcp
scripts.test:live: npm run build && npm run test:live -w @bylinecode/sdk && npm run test:live -w @bylinecode/indexer
scripts.demo: npm run demo:data && npm run dev -w @bylinecode/web -- --open /#/testnet
scripts.web: npm run build -w @bylinecode/sdk -w @bylinecode/indexer && npm run dev -w @bylinecode/web
scripts.index: npm run build:node && npm run indexer -- sync && npm run indexer -- export
scripts.demo:data: npm run build:node && npm run indexer -- seed && npm run indexer -- export --db data/demo.sqlite --network mainnet --label sample && node apps/agent/dist/agent.js --code nw5s2ea1 --rounds 3 --interval 2 && npm run indexer -- sync && npm run indexer -- export
scripts.web:mainnet: npm run build -w @bylinecode/sdk -w @bylinecode/indexer && VITE_NETWORK=mainnet npm run dev -w @bylinecode/web -- --port 5174
